module: Lateral offset of a 2D polyline whose every edge carries an outward normal. Handles corners by miter join, bevel (chamfer) or line intersection, with a miter limit for sharp angles. run builds a closed ribbon between the line and its offset.
notes: nrm must contain one normal per edge (#nrm >= #pts - 1); nrm[i] is the normal of the edge between pts[i] and pts[i+1].
A closed polyline (first and last points coincident, more than 3 points) has its seam handled as an ordinary corner.
MITER_LIMIT = 4: a miter never exceeds 4 times the offset distance.

MITER_LIMIT.desc: Maximum factor (4.0) of miter length relative to |d|.

lineIntersect.desc: Intersection of two 2D lines P + t*D and Q + s*E. Returns nil if they are parallel (determinant < 1e-9).

px.desc: x of the point of the first line.

py.desc: y of the point of the first line.

dx.desc: x of the direction of the first line.

dy.desc: y of the direction of the first line.

qx.desc: x of the point of the second line.

qy.desc: y of the point of the second line.

ex.desc: x of the direction of the second line.

ey.desc: y of the direction of the second line.

mitrePt.desc: Offset point of a vertex between two edge normals: the miter, brought back along its bisector when the angle is too sharp (limit MITER_LIMIT * |d|).

polyline.desc: Offsets a polyline laterally by the signed distance d. The corner join type is chosen by join: 'chamfer' (two points), 'miter' (one point per vertex) or other/nil (intersection of the offset edges, falling back to two points if too far).

join.desc: 'chamfer', 'miter' or nil for the intersection join.

run.desc: Builds a closed ring going from the line to its offset: the base is sunk by overlap into the mass behind (opposite side), then the outer edge is traversed in reverse.

returns.desc: Ring of {x,y} points, or nil if fewer than 2 points or |d| < 1e-4.
